Taken together, Neighbor 2 ends up closer to not mutagenic despite the alkyl chloride gain.

The neighbor has 2 rings while the query has 0 (delta -2), and the query has a higher maximum partial charge (0.3851 vs 0.2432, delta +0.1419) plus much higher fraction of sp3 carbons (1.0 vs 0.25, delta +0.75).
